test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Shivam will be invited by us.

options.text: Shivam would be invited by us.

solution:
The correct answer is **"We shall invite Shivam."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in Simple Future Tense and in Passive Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Simple Future Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• To convert a sentence from passive voice to active voice, we need to identify the subject (who is performing the action) and make it the subject of the sentence.
 
 
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Object + will/shall + be + V3 + by Subject (Passive Voice)__
 
• Subject + will/shall + V1 + object __(Active Voice__)
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *A song will be sung by Esha.​ *(Passive Voice)
 
• *Esha will sing a song. *(Active Voice)
 
 
 
• In active voice, the subject (other details) performs the action (giving) on the object (concerned teacher).
 
• In the active voice, the subject is "We" and the object is "Shivam."
 
• **"Shall" **must be used with **"We."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

Correct sentence: *We shall invite Shivam*.
